answer: One mouth, one dental chart. A licensed dentist X-rays the operator, charts every tooth, filling, crown and bridge, and signs a fresh challenge binding that chart to the agent key; the dental board holds the record and re-checks it each epoch, and a second key claiming the same mouth is rejected. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real mouths in 1,000 dental chairs at roughly $150 per exam and X-ray, about $150,000 — and no two charts match: each one is a prism of canals, roots and repairs recording the long voyage of a single mouth, a lotus no copy can bloom twice.
